core.description: Base OS packages (gcc, tmux, git, nvim), download tools

nvim.description: Neovim plugin bootstrap and stale-state pruning

docker.description: Docker container count in tmux status bar

copilot.description: GitHub Copilot CLI, editor completion, instructions

copilot-usage.description: Copilot usage scraper and tmux widget dependencies

os: Setup-wide prerequisite: setup.sh ensures python3 is present before any feature runs.
Fedora: tmux, git, gcc, neovim, bat, fastfetch, vim, wget, curl, xz, gawk, unzip.
Debian/Ubuntu: the same packages, with xz-utils instead of xz.
nvim: Always loaded: LazyVim core plugins and base editor behavior.
Always loaded LazyVim extras: coding.yanky, formatting.black, lang.docker, lang.helm, lang.json, lang.markdown, lang.python, lang.yaml, util.dot.
Always loaded lua/plugins/core: nord + Comment.nvim; auto-save.nvim; diffview.nvim; noice.nvim; smear-cursor.nvim; last-file-rec.nvim.
Always loaded UI/editing: fastfetch-powered snacks.nvim dashboard; test results sorted last in pickers; lualine with LSP-pending spinner.
Always loaded language/formatting: autotools_ls, conform bake, Mason mbake; markdownlint removed; nvim-dap and neotest disabled; persistence disabled.

os: No OS packages; uses git, curl, and neovim from core.
nvim: Bootstraps lazy.nvim and every plugin, Tree-sitter parser, and Mason package declared by the active features into ~/.local/share/nvim.
Runs scripts/headless_prune.lua on every setup to remove plugins, Mason packages, and parsers no longer declared.
Skipped on Raspberry Pi, which uses the plugin-free minimal config.
Does not gate the plugin set: base LazyVim and lua/plugins/core load even when nvim is off.

os: Fedora: cmake, gcc-c++, make.
Debian/Ubuntu: cmake, build-essential (g++, make, libc development headers).
nvim: None.

os: ble.sh 0.4.0-nightly snapshot (2026-09-08, d81fd54) downloaded to ~/.local/share/blesh.
Adds to ~/.bashrc: source ~/.bash_profile_yf; source -- ~/.local/share/blesh/ble.sh.
Symlinks ~/.bash_profile_yf and ~/.blerc.
nvim: None.

os: TPM at ~/.tmux/plugins/tpm; plugins tmux-sensible and tmux-which-key from .tmux.conf.
tmux-mem-cpu-load 3.8.3 at ~/.local/bin (pinned prebuilt; built from app-forks/tmux-mem-cpu-load when build is selected).
Symlinks ~/.tmux.conf and ~/.tmux/scripts (window-name, memory-status, docker-panel, docker-count, copilot-usage, claude-usage, and the copilot-usage-scraper).
nvim: None.

os: No packages; the tmux status scripts docker-panel.sh and docker-count.sh need an existing docker CLI.
nvim: None; the LazyVim lang.docker extra is always loaded from lazyvim.json, independent of this checkbox.

os: gh CLI from GitHub's apt repository (Debian/Ubuntu) or the gh-cli COPR (Fedora).
lazygit on Fedora from the atim/lazygit COPR; on Debian/Ubuntu setup warns and leaves installation manual.
nvim: LazyVim lang.git extra: Tree-sitter parsers git_config, gitcommit, git_rebase, gitignore, gitattributes; cmp-git completion source.
Base gitsigns.nvim is always loaded by LazyVim, not by this feature.

os: Fedora: nodejs, npm.
Debian/Ubuntu: nodejs, npm.
nvim: None; node/npm are prerequisites for Copilot, copilot-usage, and frontend Mason tooling.

os: GitHub Copilot CLI: sudo npm install -g @github/copilot.
Symlink ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md -> repo copilot-instructions.md.
nvim: LazyVim ai.copilot-chat extra: CopilotChat.nvim, <leader>a keymaps, optional edgy and blink integrations.
plugins.ai/copilot.lua: zbirenbaum/copilot.lua loaded on InsertEnter; manual suggestions only; Tab accept, M-] next, M-[ previous, C-] dismiss; panel disabled.
lua/config/keymaps.lua: insert-mode Tab accepts a Copilot suggestion and otherwise falls back to Tab.

os: Creates or patches ~/.claude/settings.json statusLine.command to repo claude-scripts/statusline.sh; repairs stale repo paths; leaves a valid external script alone.
Claude Code CLI itself is not installed by setup.
nvim: None.

os: npm install in tmux-scripts/copilot-usage-scraper (node_modules).

Playwright Chromium; Debian/Ubuntu: npx playwright install-deps chromium; Fedora: nss, nspr, atk, cups-libs, libdrm, libxkbcommon, at-spi2-atk, libXcomposite, libXdamage, libXfixes, libXrandr, mesa-libgbm, alsa-lib, pango, cairo, libxshmfence.
tmux widget tmux-scripts/copilot-usage.sh plus the scraper; credentials in ~/.config/copilot-usage are not created by setup.
nvim: None.

os: None; node/npm comes from the node feature.
nvim: LazyVim lang.typescript: vtsls language server (default), TS/JS filetype detection, keymaps gD, gR, <leader>cM, <leader>cD, <leader>cV, mini.icons.
LazyVim lang.angular: Angular/SCSS Tree-sitter parsers, angularls via Mason package angular-language-server, vtsls Angular tsserver plugin.

LazyVim formatting.prettier: Mason prettier; conform formatting for css, graphql, handlebars, html, javascript, javascriptreact, json, jsonc, less, markdown, markdown.mdx, scss, typescript, typescriptreact, vue, yaml.
Optional js-debug-adapter/DAP integration is inert because nvim-dap is disabled.

os: Fedora runtime deps: glibc, libgcc, ca-certificates, openssl-libs, libstdc++, libicu, tzdata, krb5-libs, zlib.
Debian/Ubuntu runtime deps: libc6, libgcc-s1, ca-certificates, openssl, libstdc++6, libicu-dev, tzdata, zlib1g.
Downloads ~/dotnet-install.sh and installs the .NET SDK under ~/.dotnet.
nvim: plugins/dotnet/roslyn.lua: seblyng/roslyn.nvim for cs/razor; Mason roslyn-language-server (legacy roslyn accepted) auto-installed on the first C# buffer.
Roslyn inlay-hint, completion, and background-analysis settings in lua/config/options.lua.
Keymaps: <leader><S-b> dotnet build ./src; <leader>kl csharpier format . (csharpier must already be on PATH; setup does not install it).

os: cargo if missing (Fedora: dnf cargo; Debian/Ubuntu: apt cargo).
asm-lsp at commit bacbe5e built from source with patches/asm-lsp-full-reparse.patch into ~/.local/bin.
rvfmt (riscv-asm-fmt) at commit 9247d1b built from source with patches/riscv-asm-fmt-dollar-symbol.patch into ~/.local/bin.
Symlinks ~/.config/asm-lsp/.asm-lsp.toml and ~/.local/bin/ld-format.
nvim: plugins.embedded/asm.lua: Tree-sitter asm and linkerscript; asm_lsp via nvim-lspconfig with Mason disabled, root markers, and K/gd/gR; conform rvfmt for asm and ldformat for ld; blink sources riscv_asm, asm_symbols, asm_macros; which-key gR.
Lua modules lua/riscv_asm, lua/asm_symbols, lua/asm_docs, lua/asm_macros; ftdetect/asm.lua and ftdetect/linker.lua; after/ftplugin/asm.lua comment handling.
Commands :RiscvAsmDoctor and :RiscvAsmReferences.

os: None; clangd is installed by Mason.
nvim: LazyVim lang.clangd extra: cpp Tree-sitter parser; clangd_extensions.nvim; Mason clangd server; <leader>ch switch source/header; clangd background-index, clang-tidy, iwyu, and detailed completion settings.

PlatformIO autocmd in lua/config/autocmds.lua: FileType c/cpp/objc/objcpp/cuda and BufWritePost platformio.ini run pio run -t compiledb when compile_commands.json is missing or stale; :PlatformIOCompiledb command; pio must already be on PATH.
Optional codelldb/nvim-dap integration is inert because nvim-dap is disabled.

os: Shallow clone of https://github.com/yfozekosh/gef.git, branch ch32v003-rv32ec, into ~/.local/share/gef.
Symlink ~/.gdbinit -> repo .gdbinit; it loads GEF and the CH32V003 context view.
gdb itself is not installed by setup.
nvim: None.

os: Fedora: dejavu-fonts-all, liberation-fonts-all.
Debian/Ubuntu: fonts-dejavu, fonts-liberation. Runs fc-cache -f.
nvim: None.

os: win32yank.exe v0.1.1 x64 downloaded to ~/.local/bin.
tmux copy-command and the OSC 52 clipboard hook use it when present.
nvim: lua/config/options.lua sets vim.g.clipboard to win32yank.exe (-i --crlf / -o --lf) when the binary is executable.
Sets clipboard=unnamedplus so yanks and pastes use the Windows clipboard.

os: Edits /etc/wsl.conf, adding a [boot] command that writes :WSLInterop:M::MZ::/init:PF to binfmt_misc.
Registers the binfmt entry immediately; requires sudo, and a reboot for boot persistence.
nvim: None.
